name: My Card Collection
desc:
🃏Welcome to My Card Collection!

How to Play:
🎁 Buy a pack of cards and open on the table!
📖 Cards are added to your big binder!
💸 The cards generate money!
✨ Buy better packs & flex your card collection!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, & Tablet!
